participation.context: Stopped, ate, and did not linger.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the morning's bait, and not a ceremony

story.body: You stopped at ten, ate bread and cheese, and went on. You did not make the stop a conversation.

relations.note: the morning's bait, and not a ceremony

participation.context: Said where they were and rode on.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the ridge is rain and a decision

story.body: You named the stones and refused the turning, and you did not make a visit of them.

relations.note: the ridge is rain and a decision

title: Kept the road with the stones off to the left

participation.context: Wrung the cloak and named what had to stay dry.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the sword is still dry, and still not yet in his hand

story.body: You got down, gave the bay to a boy, and wrung the cloak without wetting the sword or the ribbons.

relations.note: the sword is still dry, and still not yet in his hand
